thread:
maria.g: Hey team — noticed a mismatch on Acme Corp's month-end invoice vs dashboard. Invoice total is $4,320 higher than the dashboard. Line items show a duplicated 'Pro Plan - overage' row for the same cutoff window. Can someone help triage? :eyes:

sam.k: Account ID? invoice id?

maria.g: acct_acme_8991, invoice_2026-03-31-ACME-014. Dashboard screenshot: https://redwood.s3/secure/acme/invoice-dash.png (uploaded).

billing-bot: invoice_2026-03-31-ACME-014 generated by job invoice-generator-20260331 at 2026-04-01T01:12:07Z (status: success).

alex.h: @lee.ops can you pull the invoice row dump and meter events around the cutoff for acct_acme_8991?

lee.ops: pulling now. quick peek — dashboard export CSV shows one overage row for 2026-03-31 (tokens: 1,240,000). Invoice shows two rows: one for the snapshot (1,240,000) and one for a post-cutoff backfill (1,240,000) — same quantity duplicated.

tara: there was a backfill job (metering-backfill) that retried at midnight UTC for partitions 2026-03-31-east. I saw a retry loop earlier in the logs. Might be double-apply.

lee.ops: posting query I used to cross-check:
```
-- find invoice rows for account + matching token counts
select invoice_id, line_type, tokens, created_at, source from invoice_lineitems
where account_id = 'acct_acme_8991' and invoice_id = 'invoice_2026-03-31-ACME-014';
```

lee.ops: result: two rows with same tokens, different source values: 'snapshot' and 'backfill_v2'.

maria.g: so dashboard is reading snapshot only, but invoice included backfill too. how did backfill get applied after snapshot?

lee.ops: looks like backfill_v2 ran after snapshot cut, and the invoice pipeline didn't dedupe by event id — it just upserts by (invoice_id, line_id) where line_id was generated anew for backfill.

sam.k: do we have idempotency keys on the backfill import? I thought we were deduping on meter_event_id previously.

lee.ops: backfill_v2 currently generates a synthetic event id with prefix 'backfill-' + partition + rand(). So if the backfill reprocessed the same usage window, it creates new event ids and new lines. Snapshot was original canonical source.

alex.h: root cause hypothesis: when a retry happened the backfill reprocessed windows already captured by the snapshot and exported new lineitems that were not deduped. Need to confirm if invoice generator merges by meter_event_id or just trusts source precedence.

lee.ops: confirmed: invoice-generator merges by (invoice_id, external_line_key) where external_line_key is provided by upstream. Snapshot provided external_line_key 'snap-20260331-acc_acme_8991', backfill provided 'bf-20260331-east-xyz'. no overlap, so both inserted.

tara: logs from backfill job: "WARN partition 2026-03-31-east retry count 3, window processed" then "INFO wrote N lineitems". So it did run after snapshot success.

maria.g: what's the impact #? amount is $4,320 extra (same tokens duplicated). Customer is doing month-end close. They flagged this and asked for correction.

sam.k: can we produce a safe mitigation? either remove the backfill lines from invoice or issue a credit and fix the pipeline so this doesn't repeat.

lee.ops: quick mitigation option A: remove all invoice_lineitems where source like 'backfill_v2' for this invoice and regenerate totals. That will revert invoice to snapshot state. Quick but manual.

alex.h: option B: create a credit line on the next invoice for the duplicated amount and mark this invoice notes. Faster customer communication. Which is lower risk?

lee.ops: A needs DB edit + recompute invoice totals and ledger entries — needs accounting signoff. B is customer-facing and reversible but leaves historical invoice unchanged.

maria.g: customer expects corrected final numbers. They prefer corrected invoice if possible. Can finance approve edit? @sam.k do you have accounting contact?

sam.k: pinging finance offline. For speed, I'd recommend drafting a customer note and issuing a credit while we correct the pipeline. We'll aim to reissue corrected invoice if finance confirms it's allowed.

lee.ops: workaround to prevent recurrence before full fix: block backfill_v2 from running post-cutoff for any partition where snapshot flag exists. I can patch the backfill scheduler to skip partitions with snapshot_completed = true.

alex.h: agree. Patch and short rollback window. Also add dedupe layer in invoice-generator to ignore lines where tokens and account+period match existing snapshot lines and source != 'snapshot' — as emergency rule. We'll then design idempotent backfills properly.

billing-bot: invoice_2026-03-31-ACME-014 current total: $42,840, lines: 12, generated_at: 2026-04-01T01:12:07Z.

maria.g: can you capture the exact line_ids so finance can reference them?

lee.ops: line ids: L-991-A (snapshot, tokens 1,240,000, amount $4,320) and L-991-B (backfill_v2, tokens 1,240,000, amount $4,320). I'll attach CSV to the ticket.

tara: I'm going to run a quick patch to the backfill scheduler to hard-stop new runs for partitions < 2026-04-02 pending fix. Will post PR.

alex.h: thanks. action items:
- lee.ops: attach CSV and run proposed DB patch draft (do not apply yet)
- tara: PR for scheduler hard-stop, block post-cutoff runs
- sam.k: coordinate with finance for credit vs reissue
- alex.h + lee.ops: emergency dedupe rule in invoice-generator (hotfix PR ready)
- maria.g: draft customer-facing note, include expected timeline and temporary credit option

maria.g: customer-facing draft (first pass):
"Hi Acme team — during our month-end processing we discovered a duplicated overage line caused by a backfill job reprocessing after the snapshot. This created a duplicate charge of $4,320. We're preparing a corrected invoice or a one-time credit and will update you within 24 hours. Apologies for the disruption."

sam.k: :thumbsup: I'll loop in finance now.

lee.ops: attaching quick log snippet for the backfill run:
```
2026-04-01T00:59:58Z INFO starting partition 2026-03-31-east
2026-04-01T01:00:12Z WARN retry attempt 2 for partition 2026-03-31-east
2026-04-01T01:05:01Z INFO wrote 1 lineitems for acct_acme_8991 (bf-20260331-east-xyz)
```

maria.g: thanks all. Please keep updates here; tagging @alex.h for customer comms. :pray:

alex.h: will draft email and provide timeline. next update by EOD PST. :clock3:

lee.ops: follow-up: adding a quick query to find other accounts affected by backfill_v2 duplicates for same period. running across 2026-03-31 partitions now. Will post summary in thread when done.

billing-bot: note: invoice_2026-03-31-ACME-014 created_ledger_entries: yes. Any manual edit will require ledger adjustment.

maria.g: copy.

lee.ops: initial scan result: ~7 invoices show potential duplicate backfill lines for 2026-03-31 across multiple accounts. Not all are material; will provide full list.

maria.g: ok — prioritize Acme for now. Thanks everyone.
